To make scheduling straightforward, could you please pick two preferred windows (from the three internal options below) and confirm who will attend from your side (we’ll need an engineering lead and a product owner):

Our suggested windows (all in PST):
1) Tue Aug 5, 10:00–10:30am
2) Wed Aug 6, 2:00–2:30pm
3) Thu Aug 7, 11:30–12:00pm

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (1 page, draft MAP) — I included the outline and asks for the demo. I’ll hold off sending a formal calendar invite until you confirm the slot and attendees.

If none of these work, tell me two preferred times later next week and we’ll adapt. I’ve cc’d Marissa (solutions lead) to help with booking and prep.

Thanks — Michael
